name: constructing-idea-genomes

method.focus: encode ideas into comparable causal components rather than persuasive prose
steps: Extract target user, hidden problem, trigger, mechanism, interface, resource, incentive, ownership, time model, distribution, value, assumptions, and failure modes.
Normalize each field to one causal statement and remove marketing adjectives.
Mark inherited components versus novel mutations.
Generate a semantic fingerprint from mechanism-level fields.
Reject incomplete genomes before scoring or recombination.
verification: Could another agent reconstruct the same concept from the genome?
Does the mechanism explain how value is created?
Would a title change leave the fingerprint unchanged?
traps: using a pitch deck as the data model
encoding novelty only in the title

procedure: Freeze the challenge, constraints, forbidden defaults, and evaluation frame.
Generate independent mechanism-level candidates before cross-contamination.
Extract target user, hidden problem, trigger, mechanism, interface, resource, incentive, ownership, time model, distribution, value, assumptions, and failure modes.
Normalize each field to one causal statement and remove marketing adjectives.
Mark inherited components versus novel mutations.
Generate a semantic fingerprint from mechanism-level fields.
Reject incomplete genomes before scoring or recombination.
Apply the named divergence or mutation operation.
Represent candidates as structured idea genomes.
Remove semantic duplicates and fake novelty.
Hand off distinct candidates without selecting a winner prematurely.

rules: The output directly and completely performs constructing idea genomes within its declared boundary.
Could another agent reconstruct the same concept from the genome?
Does the mechanism explain how value is created?
Would a title change leave the fingerprint unchanged?
Every material claim is traceable to an input, decision, executable check, or evidence item.
Required fields are complete and machine-readable.
The producing agent is not the approving reviewer.
Open uncertainty and residual risk are explicit; critical findings are never hidden by an aggregate score.
gate.passCondition: All mandatory rules pass, evidence targets the current artifact hash, and no unresolved critical finding applies.

handoff.stopWhen: Output contract is satisfied, a blocker is recorded, or a material human decision is required.

failureModes: producing prose without the contracted artifact
expanding scope without a decision record
using a pitch deck as the data model
encoding novelty only in the title
description: Use when constructing idea genomes is required during creativity work, especially when the result must be traceable, independently reviewable, and safe to hand to another agent.
